subject: maths
question: Salary of Prakash was ₹75,000. If he gets an increment of 8%, then what will be his new salary?
solution:
Given:

Increment of the salary = 8%

The salary was = Rs. 75000

Calculation:

Salary after increment = 75000 + 8% of 75000 

⇒ 75000 × 108/100 = Rs. 81000

∴ The new salary is Rs. 81000
